instruction: Start only after task 0001 reports PRACTICE OS PRODUCTION RELEASE VERIFIED. Research current public product information for TaxDome, Canopy, Karbon, Financial Cents, TaxCaddy, SmartVault, Drake, Intuit ProConnect and Lacerte, CCH Axcess, UltraTax, FreeTaxUSA paid-preparer workflows, and other relevant tax-practice products. Use official pages, help docs, release notes, public demos, pricing, integrations, IRS documentation, and recent practitioner reviews. Inspect Folio and create docs/product/PREMIUM_TAX_PRODUCT_BLUEPRINT.md containing a feature matrix, user pain points, product gaps, build-vs-integrate decisions, metric definitions, information architecture, visual design principles, implementation milestones, and acceptance criteria. Folio must exceed the baseline for client portal, high-volume document collection, mobile capture, organizers, e-signatures, billing, CRM, communications, workflow automation, reporting, capacity, deadlines, extensions, e-file preparation/status visibility, IRS transcript workflows, QuickBooks integrations, tax-software interoperability, security, and onboarding. Evaluate lawful native IRS Modernized e-File participation as a Software Developer/Transmitter alongside established-transmitter integration paths; do not assume e-file must live outside Folio. Optimize for fewer manual steps, fewer context switches, exception-driven work, clear client actions, tax-season readiness, and meaningful visual metrics. Define a premium visual bar with purposeful color, calm high-density dashboards, excellent hierarchy, useful motion, polished empty/loading/error states, accessibility, responsive layouts, and white-label client experience. Do not create or activate unvalidated tax calculation or production transmission logic without the required IRS/state authorization and testing. Commit and push the blueprint. Do not deploy production.
